attempts.text:
**The window opens on a spine.** Columns 0 to 10, `hypA` to `ascB`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 4% of calls. The model names 7 to 99.8% of them, fewest at column 6, `hycF`, 7%.

**A fork follows at column 11**, `ascF`, carried by 89%. The last stretch, columns 62 to 79, is the most plastic of the window, in a region of plasticity in 31 to 51% of calls.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 96 against 78%, and hesitates less there, 0.16 against 1.23 bits. Its most hesitant column, 62, is a fork column, at 2.73 bits.

**The window ends on variable columns.** Columns 68 to 79, `recN` to `dgcN`, are carried by 19 to 57% of chromosomes, all persistent. The last column is `dgcN`, in 19% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 92% of genes**, 0.41 bits on average, perplexity 1.5 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 2.29 against 0.18 bits, and names fewer genes, 53% against 96%.

label: hypA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the hypA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor hypA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,009 to 1,088 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying hypA once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.41 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,535 calls, named 98%, 0.17 bits; shell 4,594 calls, named 60%, 1.73 bits; cloud 1,071 calls, named 21%, 3.41 bits. Outside an RGP 38,480 calls, named 96%, 0.18 bits; inside an RGP 4,720 calls, named 53%, 2.29 bits. Columns: 61 spine, 5 fork, 14 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (2.29 against 0.18 bits) and names fewer genes (53% against 96%); 4,720 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 62 ("ATPase", a fork column) 2.73 bits, RGP 31%; column 63 (ypjA, a variable column) 2.32 bits, RGP 36%; column 64 (smpB, a fork column) 2.00 bits, RGP 44%. The 2 columns (columns 66-67) where most calls are in an RGP: named 76%, 1.49 bits on average; the other 78 columns: named 92%, 0.39 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 61 spine columns: named 96%, 0.16 bits on average; the 19 fork and variable columns: named 78%, 1.23 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 62, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 62-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 31-51%; the least: columns 0-10 (spine), RGP 0-4%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-10 (11 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-4%. Genes: hypA, hycA, hycB, hycC, hycD, hycE, hycF, hycG, hycH "formate hydrogenlyase assembly prot…", hycI, ascB. named 7-99.8% (mean 89%), fewest named at column 6 (hycF), named 7%; most hesitant at column 10 (ascB), 1.17 bits.
[S2] 2. column 11 fork: share 89%, all P, RGP 4%. named 96%; 0.27 bits.
[S2.c11]    11: ascF P 89% "PTS cellobiose/arbutin/salicin tran…"; also "helix-turn-helix domain-containing prot…" S 26%, "type II toxin-antitoxin system HigB fam…" S 16%
[S3] 3. columns 12-61 (50 columns) spine: share 91-96%, all P, RGP 0-9%. Genes: ascG, hydN, hypF, norW, norV "anaerobic nitric oxide reductase fl…", norR, gutQ, srlR, gutM, srlD, srlB "PTS glucitol/sorbitol transporter s…", srlE, srlA, mltB, pncC, recA "recombinase RecA", recX, alaS, csrA, yqaB "fructose-1-phosphate/6-phosphogluco…", yqaA "YqaA family protein", gshA, luxS, emrB "multidrug efflux MFS transporter pe…", emrA, emrR, ygaH "L-valine transporter subunit YgaH", ygaZ "L-valine exporter subunit YgaZ", ygaY "MFS transporter", proX, proW "glycine betaine/L-proline ABC trans…", proV, nrdF, nrdE, nrdI "class Ib ribonucleoside-diphosphate…", nrdH, ygaM "DUF883 domain-containing protein", ygaC "DUF2002 family protein", alaE, stpA, ygaP "thiosulfate sulfurtransferase YgaP", ygaV "ArsR/SmtB family transcription fact…", yqaE "YqaE/Pmp3 family membrane protein", kbp, csiR, gabP, gabT, gabD "NADP-dependent succinate-semialdehy…", lhgO, glaH. named 92-99.6% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 61 (glaH), named 92%, 0.69 bits.
[S4] 4. columns 62-79 (18 columns) fork and variable columns: share 19-62%, 17 P, 1 S, RGP 31-51%. named 70-82% (mean 77%), fewest named at column 63, named 70%; most hesitant at column 62, 2.73 bits.
[S4.c62]    62 fork: "ATPase" P 60%; also "IS1 family transposase" S 26%
[S4.c63]    63 variable: ypjA S 50% "adhesin-like autotransporter YpjA/E…"
[S4.c64]    64 fork: smpB P 62%; also ygaR S 23%
[S4.c65]    65 fork: ratA P 62%; also ypjCB S 12%
[S4.c66]    66 variable: yfjF P 61% "RnfH family protein"
[S4.c67]    67 fork: bamE P 60%; also "integrase domain-containing protein" S 10%
[S4.c68-79]    columns 68-79 variable, share 19-57%, all P: recN 57%, nadK 55%, grpE 55%, yfjD "HlyC/CorC family transporter" 54%, ypjD "cytochrome C assembly family protein" 53%, ffh 51%, rpsP 47%, rimM 43%, trmD 37%, rplS 33%, yfiB "OmpA family protein" 27%, dgcN 19%
